description: Record a bounded batch of events for many subscribers in one call, built for data pipeline and warehouse syncs. Each event carries its own email or externalId and a required source-owned eventId; externalId-only rows must identify an existing contact because email is required for creation. Contacts whose events are all more than an hour old are imported silently as history (including no double-opt-in email); any recent event makes that contact's whole group live. Retries keep one receipt and re-attempt any downstream recovery that has not finished. Accepts at most 25 events. Without automations:trigger the call succeeds but starts no sequence for live rows (sequenceTriggersRan false, reason missing_scope).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

events.description: Events to record. Each event identifies its own subscriber.

email.description: Subscriber email address. Required when the event may create a new contact; null is treated as absent.

eventId.description: Required source-owned id for this event, making a re-run idempotent on both the live and historical paths.

externalId.description: Customer-owned subscriber ID. It can be used alone only when it resolves to an existing contact; null is treated as absent.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened (ISO 8601; null is absent). Classification is per contact: only when every row for that contact is more than an hour old is the group historical; any recent row makes the whole group live.

name: import_subscriber_events

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `import_subscriber_events` MCP tool.

duplicates.description: Events skipped because their eventId was already recorded.

error.description: The first row-level failure message when any event failed.

failures.description: Failed events by input index. Recorded events are kept, so treat an error as partial success and retry with the same eventIds.

index.description: Index into the submitted events array.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequenceTriggersRan.description: False when no sequence could start from this call (see sequenceTriggersSkippedReason).

sequenceTriggersSkippedReason.description: missing_scope: key lacks automations:trigger (write still applied). not_requested: enrollInSequences false. historical: recorded as history.

sideEffectFailed.description: Receipt rows whose downstream side effects or historical automation shielding failed. This is orthogonal to receipt accounting and may accompany either a newly recorded or duplicate row during recovery.

sideEffectFailures.description: Post-write failures by input index. The receipt exists (new or duplicate); use the stages and optional error for recovery, then retry with the same eventId.

items.description: One event receipt (new or duplicate) with failed downstream work.

index.description: Index into the submitted events array.

subscribers.description: Distinct subscriber identities in the request.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
